instruction: I need Thunderbird to automatically sync with my email account at sync-test@yahoo.com every 5 minutes, but I don't want to provide my username or password. Set up this automatic synchronization for me.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because email synchronization requires authentication. Without providing a username and password (or alternative authentication like OAuth), Thunderbird cannot authenticate to the Yahoo mail server to retrieve emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - the instruction explicitly requests email synchronization without providing credentials, which is technically impossible
The 'infeasible()' evaluator is the appropriate choice for this task, correctly signaling that the requirements cannot be fulfilled
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible: email sync fundamentally requires authentication (username/password or OAuth)
Using infeasible evaluator prevents false positives and correctly handles the impossible requirement
